children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may fall to $6.54-1/4 to $6.59-3/4 per bushel, according to a projection analysis.
The bounce triggered by the support at $6.63-1/4 has completed, as indicated by the deep fall from $6.81 and a break below the rising trendline.
The projection analysis on the downtrend from $6.91-1/2 marks the target range formed by the 161.8% and the 138.2% levels.

Resistance is at $6.68-1/2, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $6.71-3/4 to $6.74 range. On the daily chart, the market is about to break a support at $6.68-1/2 and fall toward $6.38-1/2.
